weighting: Each previous-game metric is weighted by its own count of non-missing FTN charted plays within that metric's defined population; missing values are excluded, never treated as zero.

population_definitions.all_scrimmage_plays: All matched run and pass scrimmage plays

limitations: The latest game is the latest represented in the current PBP/FTN snapshot and may be partial while sources update.
Changes are descriptive and do not establish causation, coverage calls, or individual defender assignments.
